instances.claim: This tells me that the draft has already shown cents changing hands for thousands of dollars.
instances.why: Line 7's absurdity is anchored by line 3 (currency that buys nothing), but line 8's parallel construction presupposes a fact the draft never states — that a cent is ever valued at thousands — and line 9's "here we are" asserts both absurdities are actual, converting the missing premise into a conclusion the piece never earned.
